title: Exports
description: The STL export (deferred part 5; the original's File ▸ Export STL and Export Solution Pieces to STL, src/lib/stl*.cpp, cubemesh, minkmesh): each grid's mesher parameters, a shape's STL mesh for the dialog's preview with its volume, the STL file as bytes (the client writes it where its user chose), and the pieces of a solution's export with their file names. The cube, prism, rhombic and tetra-octa grids share six parameters (the cube grids' mesh comes from a table of chamfered corners, the others' from Minkowski sums with the Manifold library, seconds for large shapes in a release build), the sphere grid has eight. Allowed while solving: they only read shapes.

export.stlParameters.summary: The STL parameters of a grid, in order, as the original's export dialog showed them: name, kind of value, default, tooltip. The values of export.stlMesh and export.stl follow this order.

export.stlMesh.summary: A shape's STL mesh for the parameter values, as a binary frame with the arrays of a MeshFrame (the export dialog's preview: the mesh before its coplanar faces are merged for the file), with the volume it encloses (the dialog's 'Volume: x cubic-units'). Refused with the original's words for a shape with variable cells, a value out of range, more than 6 recursions on the sphere grid (not a limit of the original: its mesh failed from 6 on), or a mesh that comes out faulty ('The generated mesh is faulty in some way, try to tweak the parameter').

result.description: A MeshFrame (its hotspot 0 0 0) and the volume.

volume.description: In cubic units of the unit size (the mesh's own units).

export.stl.summary: A shape's STL file, as a binary frame with one array, file (u8): the mesh for the parameter values with its coplanar faces merged and triangulated again, each face a fan of triangles, binary or text as the original wrote it. Refused as export.stlMesh.

binary.description: Binary STL (the dialog's 'Binary STL'); default true. Otherwise text.

name.description: What the file says its solid is: the binary header (its first 80 bytes) or the text's 'solid' line; the original wrote the file's name there. Default empty. No control characters, at most 255 bytes.

export.solutionPieces.summary: What the original's Export Solution Pieces to STL writes for a saved solution: the distinct shapes its assembly places (not the problem's counts), in shape order, with how many copies and their file's name: the shape's name, or S<n> without one, every byte but ASCII letters, digits, '-' and '_' made '_', '-S<n>' added when an earlier piece's file has that name, then '.stl'. Allowed while solving.

StlParameter.description: One parameter of a grid's STL mesher (stlExporter_c's getParameterName, getParameterType, getParameter of a new exporter, getParameterTooltip).

name.description: The original's label: Unit Size, Unit Size Y, Unit Size Z, Bevel, Offset, Interior chamfers; on the sphere grid Sphere radius, Connection radius, Curvature radius, Offset, Recursions, Inner radius, Hole diameter, Square Hole.

type.description: The field: any number, a number of 0 or more, a whole number of 0 or more, or a check box (1 on, 0 off).

StlValues.description: One value per parameter of the document's grid, in export.stlParameters' order (another count: invalid_argument). Default: the defaults.
